subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose channel creation through the message tool/CLI, and if so what explicit Slack and Discord admin gates, scopes, requester checks, and docs are required?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but implementation grants workspace/server administration authority and likely adds new Slack config/setup surface, so automation should not choose the permanent policy boundary.

options.title: Approve gated provider-owned support
options.body: Define an explicit channel-management action gate and required provider scopes/permissions, then implement Slack channel creation plus Discord CLI/docs parity inside the provider boundaries.

options.title: Land Discord CLI only
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65065 or an equivalent replacement as the narrow Discord CLI/docs fix and keep Slack/admin creation as a separate reviewed design.

options.title: Keep creation external
options.body: Decline native channel creation for now and document provider API workarounds until maintainers want this administration surface in OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Approve gated provider-owned support
recommendation.body: Define an explicit channel-management action gate and required provider scopes/permissions, then implement Slack channel creation plus Discord CLI/docs parity inside the provider boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from recent surface work and prior review on the exact CLI, Slack, Discord, and docs paths.
